notes: This is a single hardware sample, not a repeated A/B baseline.
The local app loaded 3489 city elements for the spawn cell and one terrain tile.
The remote city-cache request hit a cross-origin failure; two neighboring API requests later returned 502 during this route session.
Renderer and GPU histories use bounded 1200-sample rings.
WebGL2 disjoint timer queries were supported; report results were read only after availability and no disjoint samples were dropped.
Single fixed-medium hardware run on Intel UHD 630; use as a diagnostic sample, not an A/B conclusion. Spawn cell was warm from IndexedDB; adjacent-cell streaming failures limit the scene comparison.
